content:
Last week saw significant price drops across a number of current Apple products, from 25% off the AirPods Pro 3 to the latest AirPods Max 2 at $120 below its original price — but the deals aren't over yet. While those discounts are still live, Amazon just dropped Apple's AirTag 2 to its lowest price ever — at roughly $20 per unit.

We already covered a few record-low AirTag 2 deals during last week's anniversary sale promotions. If you missed those, don't worry — the price has now dropped even further to the best deals we've ever tracked.

Amazon still has the single-pack AirTag 2 at $24 — matching the lowest price we've seen since launch. But the 4-pack has now dropped to $79.99, with free shipping.

Apple's official 4-pack pricing is $99, which is already a better value than the $29-per-unit single pack. Now selling at nearly 20% off, that works out to $20 per AirTag 2 — a brand-new record low.

While last week's $90 4-pack deal, combined with major retailers' anniversary sales, was nearly guaranteed to last the whole week, this new record low from Amazon could go either way — it could jump back up at any moment.

We've previously compared the original AirTag with this year's AirTag 2 — you can check that out here — here's a quick summary of the highlights:

  • Precision finding range extended by 1.5x
  • Speaker volume up to 50% louder than the previous generation
  • The AirTag 2 can be heard "from twice as far away"
  • Features "a set of industry-first anti-stalking protections"

More new AirTag 2 features are on the way

AirTag 2 drops to $20 each, arriving ahead of iOS 27 and watchOS 27, both set to launch next month. For Apple Watch users, there's a welcome upgrade: the Find My app now supports Precision Finding. That means you can now use your Apple Watch with on-screen arrows and specific distance info to locate an AirTag.

watchOS 27 also unifies the Find My experience into a single app. On Apple Watch, Find My was previously split across three separate app icons for People, Items, and Devices, arranged as tiles or in a list on the app screen.

Meanwhile, iOS 27's Find My app gets a brand-new design and interface, making it easier to track both people and items.

With all that in mind, now is the perfect time to expand your AirTag 2 collection — especially at this price.

More Apple deals this week:

  • AirPods Max 2: $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3: $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4: $99 (originally $129)
